text: 易观千帆最新数据显示，2026年6月证券类App月活用户规模达1.86亿人，环比增长1.78%，同比增长15.08%。具体来看，第三方服务App中，同花顺、东方财富、大智慧位列前三，月活用户人数分别为3852.57万、1917.62万和1374.66万。券商自营App方面，华泰证券涨乐财富通、国泰海通君弘、平安证券等位居前列，其中涨乐财富通以1283.53万月活领跑。（上证报）
text_en: According to the latest data from Analysys Qianfan, the monthly active user (MAU) scale of securities apps in June 2026 reached 186 million, up 1.78% month-on-month and 15.08% year-on-year. Specifically, among third-party service apps, Tongdaxin, East Money, and Dazhihui ranked in the top three, with MAU of 38.5257 million, 19.1762 million, and 13.7466 million, respectively. For broker-owned apps, Huatai Securities' Zhang Le Fortune, Guotai Haitong Jun Hong, and Ping An Securities ranked among the top, with Zhang Le Fortune leading with an MAU of 12.8353 million. (Shanghai Securities News)
